description: Request a free Cloud Basic SSL certificate (Certificate Manager 2.0). DCV is by DNS CNAME record (validationMethod D) — check ncloud_cm2_get_dcv_status afterwards for the record to create. Use dryRun=true to preview. Public zone only. Works with main-account and Sub Account keys (Sub Account verified 2026-11-25; earlier the 2.0 API rejected Sub Account keys with HTTP 403).

dnsName.description: Domains for the certificate SAN (Subject Alternative Name)

dryRun.description: If true, returns a preview without requesting

validationMethod.description: DCV method: D = DNS CNAME record (the only documented value)

name: ncloud_cm2_request_cloud_basic_certificate
